user.title: Connect to Eltako Series 62/64 IP
user.description: Enter the IP address and the Proof of Possession (PoP) code from the device sticker.

discovery_confirm.title: Discovered {name}
discovery_confirm.description: An Eltako IP device ({name} at {host}) was discovered on your network. Enter the Proof of Possession (PoP) code from the device sticker to complete setup.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Eltako Series 62/64 IP
reconfigure.description: Update connection settings or the Proof of Possession (PoP) code for this device.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Eltako Series 62/64 IP
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the updated Proof of Possession (PoP) code for your Eltako gateway.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Eltako device.

abort.already_configured: Device is already configured in Home Assistant.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the discovered Eltako device.
abort.another_device: The configured host belongs to a different Eltako device (different serial number).

init.title: Eltako Gateway Options
init.description: Configure polling interval, EnOcean repeater level, or launch the interactive EnOcean pairing wizard.

pair_enocean.title: Pair EnOcean Sensor
pair_enocean.description: Enter the hexadecimal Device ID printed on the back of your sensor (e.g., 5AA986C), or trigger the sensor and check 'Refresh Scan Results' to select a discovered radio telegram.

data.eur_id: EnOcean Device ID (Hex Sticker ID or Discovered Sensor)
data.product_guid: Product Profile (e.g., FTK for Window/Door Contact)

legacy_pair_enocean.title: Bidirectional Legacy EnOcean Actuator Pairing
legacy_pair_enocean.description: Pair a legacy EnOcean actuator (FSR61, FUD61, FSB61, FHK14) using bidirectional teach-in.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to communicate with the Eltako gateway.
error.no_device_selected: Please select a discovered sensor or enter its hexadecimal Device ID (e.g., 5AA986C).
error.invalid_eur_id: Invalid EnOcean Device ID. Enter the 7-8 character hexadecimal ID from the device sticker (e.g., 5AA986C).
error.pairing_failed: EnOcean pairing failed on the gateway.
